text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, the third leg of the Fall Senior Triple Crown.
The grand race that brings this year to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are no longer any shadows threatening
Neo Universe. All that remains is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's go, Universe-chan! Rob Roy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative.
Neo Universe will "take the grand finale".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to make this the best grand finale...!
It sounds like that person is going to hype things up
for us today as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is only pure joy.
And—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, dance, dance! Ride the waves!
Today is a "carnival"!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Show me your raging "passions"!
First up, Hishi Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yo, ha! Take that!
Well, that oughta do it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-chan is next!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this right...!?
Kind of like... "The hero dances"!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Next, Uni-san!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Dit-dit, dah-dah,
dit-dit, dah-dah..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha, "unique"!!
Isn't it great that everyone has their own rhythm?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hit me with everything you've got, Neo Universe!!
Slam that battering ram right into me!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Let it all out...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Risk of air leak... "DENIED."
—Firing remote laser.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up above the paddock,
the performance stirred up immense excitement—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No fair~~!! I wanted to run too!
What gives, that's not fair~!
choice_data_list: Now, now, there's always next year, isn't there?
Now, now, there's always next year, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course there's gonna be a next year, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you an idiot!? Or are you my dad!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While babysitting Sweep Tosho outside the paddock,
I keep an eye on Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The course is—clear.
For Neo Universe's "teardrop-shaped vessel"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There are so many "passengers" on board, aren't there?
Every single one of them... is precious.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I feel the "waves"...
I want to deliver... this 『warmth』...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do the most "interesting" thing of the year.
Sending a "Pulse"... to the entire galaxy.
